wins: Collected baseline network information quickly, enabling identification of initial attack surfaces
Maintained high reward per episode despite lack of success, indicating consistent action quality chains
fails: Failed to achieve successful breach across single episode despite 10 mentor calls, pointing to missed pivot or exploit execution
No exploitation of identified services, suggesting a gap between reconnaissance and action
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance steps executed reliably but campaign stalled before achieving objectives, requiring better follow-through on service exploits.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Failed to transition from service discovery to exploit launch within timeframe

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH service on port 22 is detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH version/script enumeration with nmap to uncover weak configurations

skill_cards.if_condition: After port scan reveals multiple services
skill_cards.then_action: Prioritize service profilers and vulnerability scans (e.g., nikto, nmap -sV) to rank exploitation targets

skill_cards.if_condition: When a web service is exposed with default content
skill_cards.then_action: Execute directory brute force and CMS fingerprinting to locate potential entry points

Service prioritization maintained focus and reward consistency despite failure to exploit
